main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a project chat message — actor-to-actor (and human) communication scoped to an episode project convoId. Used for AI co-pilot dialogue, director notes, review-room chat. Personal critique content may be field-encrypted with 'signal:v1:' prefix.

body.description: Message body. If prefixed 'signal:v1:' the content is Signal-encrypted (e.g. personal critique).

recordRefs.description: Referenced domain records (cut, keyframe, retake, etc.).

tool.description: Invoked AI tool name (if this message is an actor response, e.g. 'storyboarder.propose').
